text:
Thank you for writing to the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. You told us that your trip with your companion animal was disrupted by a delayed departure and that the way the situation was handled left you feeling let down and unsure about what support you would receive.

I am sorry for the stress that caused. When a flight changes like that, the extra waiting can be hard on both a traveler and a pet, especially when the plan had already been carefully set up around comfort, timing, and calm handling. We expect prompt, respectful communication from our teams, and I want to reassure you that we are treating your concerns as a real service issue, not just a routine delay.

For the delayed departure, the standard payout is <<FACT F109>>. Please note that this is separate from any review of additional expenses or service recovery steps that may apply to your case. Our goal is to make sure the handling of companion animal travel stays practical and safe, and that passengers are not left guessing about what comes next.

We have also shared your report with the relevant crew support team so they can review the communication trail and the timing of the updates that were given to you. That review helps us check whether the instructions passed along to the crew matched our usual expectations for companion animal travel. If there was any gap in care, we want to find it and correct it.

If you are still waiting on follow-up, please reply with the booking details already on file and the name of the traveler so we can keep the case moving without making you repeat yourself more than needed. We know that traveling with a pet can already require careful planning, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to help reduce avoidable stress, not add to it.

Thank you again for reaching out and for giving us the chance to look into this. We appreciate the patience it takes to report a problem while still dealing with the trip itself, and we will keep working to make the process clearer and more dependable.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
